summary: Hezbollah has been ordered by Iran to raise military readiness to peak levels and implement a new decentralized combat system to withstand Israeli leadership strikes. Israeli forces demolished a 1.5-kilometer Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line into Gaza using combat engineers and the Yahalom unit. U.S. military planners have developed options including potential MOAB strikes on Iranian nuclear and energy infrastructure.
key_points: Hezbollah raised to peak alert by Iran and fielding new combat system granting field units wider autonomy to survive command decapitation (Source: @yediotnews25/136312)
IDF destroyed 1.5km Hamas tunnel crossing Yellow Line into Israeli-held Gaza, operated by Gaza Division and Yahalom unit (Source: @manniefabian/59353)
IRGC Basij commander Afsaneh Aqila killed in attack in Sistan and Baluchestan Province, Iran (Source: @shin_persian/11127)

Houthis launched missiles toward Saudi Arabia triggering sirens in Najran and Jazan; explosions reported in Strait of Hormuz with RSAF striking Sana'a (Source: @shin_persian/11129, @yediotnews25/136303)
U.S. military developed new strike plans for Iran including potential use of MOAB against energy and nuclear sites (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8376)
Israel signed deal for 12 AH-64E Apache helicopters from Boeing with delivery starting early 2030s (Source: @manniefabian/59352)
Iran issued evacuation orders for multiple bases; launcher movement spotted in Marand, East Azerbaijan Province (Source: @shin_persian/11130, @shin_persian/11135)
Israeli SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Shavit and Nachshon Eitam) conducting electronic surveillance over Palestine at altitudes up to 39,025 ft (Source: @redlinkleb/48104, @redlinkleb/48106)

sections.executive_summary: Hezbollah has been ordered by Iran to raise military readiness to peak levels and implement a new decentralized combat system to withstand Israeli leadership strikes. Israeli forces demolished a 1.5-kilometer Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line into Gaza using combat engineers and the Yahalom unit. U.S. military planners have developed options including potential MOAB strikes on Iranian nuclear and energy infrastructure.

points: Iran issued evacuation orders for an unspecified number of military bases across the country, per delayed reporting from FromIran monitoring channel (Source: @shin_persian/11130).
A missile launcher was observed moving in Marand, East Azerbaijan Province, indicating possible redeployment of ballistic missile assets in northwestern Iran (Source: @shin_persian/11135).

IRGC member Afsaneh Aqila, commander of the Shahideh Afzal women's Basij unit in Mehrestan, was killed in an attack in Sistan and Baluchestan Province, highlighting ongoing internal security threats (Source: @shin_persian/11127).

U.S. military officials have developed new strike plans that include potentially using the GBU-43/B MOAB to target Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear sites should President Trump order combat operations (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8376).
Israeli media reports growing signs of a potential pre-election attack on Iran, though no operational details or timelines are specified (Source: @amitsegal/65805).

IDF combat engineers from the Gaza Division and elite Yahalom unit demolished a Hamas tunnel spanning 1.5 kilometers that crossed the Yellow Line into Israeli-held Gaza, featuring multiple rooms for operative habitation (Source: @manniefabian/59353).
Israeli Air Force GLF5 SIGINT aircraft Nachshon Shavit (registration 679, squawk 1514) conducted electronic surveillance over Palestine at 24,150 feet (Source: @redlinkleb/48104).

A second Israeli GLF5 SIGINT platform, Nachshon Eitam (registration 452, call sign IRON, squawk 1515), operated at 39,025 feet over Palestine for communications interception (Source: @redlinkleb/48106).

Israel finalized a U.S. Foreign Military Sales deal for 12 AH-64E Apache Guardian helicopters, the newest variant, with deliveries slated to begin in the early 2030s after a 1 billion shekel transfer (Source: @manniefabian/59352).

Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot pledged to destroy Hamas's military wing within 18 months of assuming premiership, citing either Trump plan implementation or direct military action (Source: @amitsegal/65816).
Israeli fighter jets were tracked operating in the southern sector, consistent with ongoing border surveillance and strike readiness (Source: @redlinkleb/48108, @redlinkleb/48052).

Hamas tunnel network extending 1.5 kilometers from Gaza into Israeli territory was neutralized by Yahalom and Gaza Division engineers, eliminating a cross-border infiltration route with underground living quarters (Source: @manniefabian/59353).

Israeli police arrested a 22-year-old from Lod studying in Kiryat Arba yeshiva for allegedly pepper-spraying and robbing a Palestinian driver in the West Bank with an accomplice (Source: @N12chat/230197).
No major ground operations, airstrikes, or casualty figures reported in Gaza or West Bank beyond the tunnel demolition and isolated arrest incident during this reporting window.

Hezbollah elevated military readiness to maximum level on Iranian orders and is activating a new combat management system designed to grant field units broad operational autonomy, reducing vulnerability to Israeli decapitation strikes against central command (Source: @yediotnews25/136312).
Artillery shelling struck Aita al-Jabal in southern Lebanon, with live map tracking confirming impacts (Source: @redlinkleb/48092).
Fire bursts were reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, indicating ongoing kinetic exchanges along the Blue Line (Source: @redlinkleb/48073).
Additional artillery fire hit Haddata and Haris in southern Lebanon, per live mapping feeds (Source: @redlinkleb/48078, @redlinkleb/48079).
An explosion occurred in the town of Barish between 11:00 and 14:00 local time, cause unspecified (Source: @redlinkleb/48105).
Israeli fighter jets maintained persistent presence in southern Lebanese airspace, per tracking data (Source: @redlinkleb/48108, @redlinkleb/48052).

No explicit operational reporting from Syria or Iraq in the provided messages. Iranian launcher movement in East Azerbaijan Province (Marand) may relate to northern supply routes but no direct linkage stated (Source: @shin_persian/11135).
Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles toward Saudi Arabia, triggering air raid sirens in Najran and Jazan regions (Source: @yediotnews25/136303).
Explosions were reported in the Strait of Hormuz concurrent with Royal Saudi Air Force strikes on Sana'a, suggesting maritime targeting and retaliatory dynamics (Source: @shin_persian/11129).
Houthi militants are attempting to indigenously manufacture Khaibarshekan-series medium-range ballistic missiles in Yemen, per a Conflict Armament Research report (Source: @shin_persian/11125).
Renewed Yemen fighting has cut off 800,000 people from UN food aid; frontline hospitals admitted over 700 war-wounded patients in a single week (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8375).

A Comoros-flagged tanker, YARA J, was struck by drones at the Sulina Canal entrance in Romanian territorial waters, marking the first such attack inside NATO waters, though Houthi attribution not confirmed in source (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8382).

key_developments: Hezbollah placed on peak alert by Iran with new decentralized command structure to survive Israeli leadership targeting (Source: @yediotnews25/136312)
IDF Yahalom unit and Gaza Division destroyed 1.5km Hamas tunnel crossing Yellow Line into Israel with multiple underground rooms (Source: @manniefabian/59353)
IRGC Basij women's unit commander Afsaneh Aqila killed in Sistan and Baluchestan attack (Source: @shin_persian/11127)
Houthi missiles fired at Saudi Arabia (Najran, Jazan); explosions in Strait of Hormuz with RSAF striking Sana'a (Source: @shin_persian/11129, @yediotnews25/136303)
U.S. military planning includes MOAB options against Iranian nuclear and energy sites per CNN sources (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8376)
Israel procuring 12 AH-64E Apaches from Boeing, delivery early 2030s (Source: @manniefabian/59352)
Iran evacuating multiple bases; launcher movement detected in Marand, East Azerbaijan (Source: @shin_persian/11130, @shin_persian/11135)
sections.threat_assessment: Hezbollah's Iranian-directed shift to a decentralized combat architecture significantly complicates Israeli targeting calculus, as decapitating central command will no longer degrade field unit effectiveness. Simultaneous Houthi missile launches toward Saudi Arabia and suspected shipping attacks in the Strait of Hormuz indicate a coordinated multi-front pressure campaign. The U.S. development of MOAB-inclusive strike plans for Iran signals a lowered threshold for kinetic escalation against nuclear infrastructure. Israel's Apache procurement and persistent SIGINT flights reflect long-term force posture adjustments rather than immediate operational tempo.
sections.regional_response: Iran is dispersing assets (base evacuations, launcher movement) while activating proxies to maximum readiness. Saudi Arabia is employing air power against Houthi command centers in Sana'a in response to cross-border missile fire. The U.S. is signaling credible military options against Iranian strategic targets, potentially deterring further proxy escalation. Israel continues systematic tunnel neutralization in Gaza and invests in next-generation rotary-wing capabilities. No unified Arab diplomatic response evident in current reporting.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Khaibarshekan missile indigenization effort in Yemen, if successful, would extend Houthi strike range and complicate Gulf air defense. The killing of a senior IRGC Basij commander in Baluchestan suggests active internal opposition or foreign intelligence penetration. Israeli SIGINT orbits over Palestine at varying altitudes indicate persistent electronic order-of-battle monitoring. The Romanian tanker strike, if Houthi-linked, marks a significant escalation in maritime targeting into NATO waters. Monitoring for Iranian missile force dispersal patterns and Hezbollah field unit autonomy implementation is critical.
